findings.text: follow-on: the mechanism paragraph says the shared exit removes the run directory on every launching-nothing path and names 'the no-eligible-lane hold', but that hold is the non-plan subject's branch in _dispatch_composed_review and returns without calling _discard_composed_plan_review; the five exits that do call it are the no-project/no-repo refusal, the unavailable-local-lane hold and the BudgetHold, LanePaused and CrewError branches. The outcome is correct for a plan subject, which never reaches the non-plan branch, so this is a landing-prose over-enumeration the node can correct by a later edit.

follow-on: the module documented for the discard behaviour carries an unrelated case, test_the_docstring_citation_of_store_delivered_report_still_resolves, which asserts a docstring citation that already resolves at the base revision and that no path in this change touches; it can never fail because of this node's work and dilutes the module's identity, and the landing fragment's 'all six cases' describes only the five mechanism cases.

item_verdicts.call_sites: no production call sites added; the shared exit is private to the dispatch
item_verdicts.diff: Read against base 25460c88; two commits. 2b68ccf6d adds _missing_ancestors, records report_directories_created in _review_dispatch_fields, and adds _discard_composed_plan_review called from five launching-nothing exits of _dispatch_composed_review, plus the six-case test module. 57b5c9224 lands the evidence fragment. The removal is one shared private function; no branch removes the directory itself.
item_verdicts.done_when: Every section-27 done-when condition holds at head: a paused-lane refusal on a synthetic project leaves no new directory under the report root and still returns lane-paused (test_a_paused_lane_leaves_no_run_directory_and_still_reports_lane_paused); an admitted dispatch keeps its directory with brief, snapshot and sidecar (test_an_admitted_dispatch_keeps_its_run_directory); a directory that existed before the call survives a refusal untouched (test_a_run_directory_that_existed_before_the_call_survives_a_refusal); the existing review-dispatch tests pass (49 passed at base); public_definitions is 1481 at both base 25460c88 and head 57b5c922, read independently of the reviewed manifest. The one-time cleanup of stale attempt directories is, by the plan's own words, a separate operational node and is not part of this change.
item_verdicts.goal: The node implements section 27's dispatch half exactly: a plan-review attempt that launches nothing leaves no run directory behind. The composer _review_dispatch_fields records the directories it brought into being in report_directories_created, and one private exit, _discard_composed_plan_review (reckon/crew/recovery.py:2487), removes exactly those on every exit that launches nothing for a plan subject - the no-project/no-repo refusal, the unavailable-local-lane hold, and the BudgetHold, LanePaused and CrewError branches (five call sites) - and never removes a directory that already existed when the call began. The refusal payload is unchanged: a paused lane still returns error lane-paused with the gate it read. Verified at head 57b5c922 and reproduced independently.
item_verdicts.manifest: Reads status complete, commits 2b68ccf6d and 57b5c922, names the gate command and its result (55 passed at head / 49 at base), and carries test_logs gate-head.log, gate-base.log and negative-control-lane-paused.log under the run directory. It records baseline_suite and after_suite arms naming revision, command, exit and log_path, and measurement_module/measurement_cwd for the base scratch tree; I reproduced the head arm, the base arm and the negative control independently.
item_verdicts.write_paths: Every changed path lies inside the run's declared write paths: reckon/crew/recovery.py, tests/test_a_review_attempt_that_launches_nothing_leaves_nothing.py and docs/evidence/fragments/a-plan-is-reviewed-before-it-is-built/a-review-attempt-that-launches-nothing-leaves-nothing.html, per the diffstat of 25460c88..57b5c922. No shared index, sprint state or other plan was touched.

justifications.durability: The guard is mutation-proven: skipping the shared exit on the lane-paused branch leaves the composed directory behind and reddens the paused-lane case. The 'already existed' half is covered by a test that seeds a delivered report.md and asserts it survives the refusal untouched, and _missing_ancestors returns nothing when the directory exists, so the discard early-returns. Removal is deepest-first with ancestor pruning, under the per-root dispatch lock, so it removes exactly what it created.
justifications.evidence: The head arm reproduces (55 passed, EXIT=0, header naming module.__file__ and cwd in a scratch extraction of 57b5c922), the base arm reproduces (49 passed, EXIT=0), the declared negative control reproduces (skip the shared exit on the lane-paused branch: EXIT=1, 1 failed, 5 passed, the failing id being the paused-lane case the head arm passes), the head test module fails three cases at base including the paused-lane case, so the test is a genuine reproduction, public_definitions is 1481 at base and 1481 at head. Deducted two: the landing fragment says the shared exit removes the directory on 'the no-eligible-lane hold', but that hold is a non-plan subject's branch that returns without calling it (harmless - no plan-review directory is composed for a non-plan subject - but the prose over-enumerates the exits); and the fragment's measure paragraph counts 'all six cases' while describing only the five mechanism cases, the sixth being an unrelated assertion.
justifications.fit: The new definitions are named by the mechanism they perform (_missing_ancestors, _discard_composed_plan_review, report_directories_created), the shared exit is private (leading underscore) so the interface count is unmoved, and no plan, sprint or ticket identifier appears in code, symbols or the test module's identity. Deducted one because the test module is named and documented for the discard behaviour yet carries an unrelated always-true case (test_the_docstring_citation_of_store_delivered_report_still_resolves), asserting a pre-existing citation that no code path here changes.
justifications.goal_fidelity: The node does exactly what section 27 asks of the dispatch: it removes the run directory it composed whenever the dispatch launches nothing, through one shared exit the refusal branches call rather than a removal copied into each, and never a directory it did not create. All five launching-nothing exits reached by a plan subject carry the call; the add is private so nothing public changes.
justifications.reuse: The removal is one shared function called from every refusal branch rather than copied into each, _missing_ancestors reuses the mkdir(parents=True) semantics it mirrors, and the composer reuses the existing directory it already computed rather than re-deriving the path.
justifications.scope_discipline: Every changed path lies inside the run's declared write paths and the evidence-fragment directory; no shared index, sprint state or other plan was touched; the second commit stayed inside the declared evidence path.
